question: For every tissue in the consensus RNA data, give the number of tissue enriched genes, the share of them secreted to blood, and the share that are FDA approved drug targets. Draw a bar chart of the twenty tissues with the most enriched genes and a heatmap of the ten tissues with the most enriched genes against the eight most common protein classes among their enriched genes. Provide the table.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specificity\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Secretome location\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"Protein class\", COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%FDA%' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"SELECT \"RNA tissue specific nTPM\", COUNT(*) FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH e AS (SELECT split_part(\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\", ':', 1) AS tissue, Gene, \"Secretome location\"='Secreted to blood' AS blood, \"Protein class\" ILIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' AS fda FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched') SELECT t.Tissue, COUNT(e.Gene) AS enriched_genes, SUM(CASE WHEN e.blood THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS secreted_to_blood_n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN e.blood THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.Gene),0),2) AS secreted_to_blood_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN e.fda THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fda_target_n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN e.fda THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.Gene),0),2) AS fda_target_pct FROM rna_tissue_consensus_tissues t LEFT JOIN e ON t.Tissue=e.tissue GROUP BY t.Tissue ORDER BY enriched_genes DESC, t.Tissue"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH e AS (SELECT split_part(\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\", ':', 1) tissue, Gene, trim(pc) protein_class FROM proteinatlas, UNNEST(string_split(\"Protein class\", ',')) AS u(pc) WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched'), top10 AS (SELECT tissue FROM (SELECT split_part(\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\", ':', 1) tissue, COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, tissue LIMIT 10)), classes AS (SELECT protein_class, COUNT(*) n FROM e JOIN top10 USING(tissue) WHERE protein_class<>'' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, protein_class LIMIT 8) SELECT e.tissue, e.protein_class, COUNT(*) n FROM e JOIN top10 USING(tissue) JOIN classes USING(protein_class) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH e AS (SELECT split_part(\"RNA tissue specific nTPM\", ':', 1) tissue, Gene FROM proteinatlas WHERE \"RNA tissue specificity\"='Tissue enriched'), top10 AS (SELECT tissue FROM e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, tissue LIMIT 10) SELECT pc protein_class, COUNT(*) n FROM proteinatlas p JOIN e ON p.Gene=e.Gene JOIN top10 ON e.tissue=top10.tissue, UNNEST(string_split(p.\"Protein class\", ',')) u(pc) WHERE trim(pc)<>'' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC, 1 LIMIT 8"}

tool_uses.input: {"query":"WITH x AS (SELECT Gene, Tissue, TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) val, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Gene ORDER BY TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) DESC) rn, LEAD(TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE)) OVER(PARTITION BY Gene ORDER BY TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) DESC) secondval FROM rna_tissue_consensus), e AS (SELECT x.Tissue, x.Gene, p.\"Secretome location\"='Secreted to blood' blood, p.\"Protein class\" ILIKE '%FDA approved drug targets%' fda FROM x JOIN proteinatlas p USING(Gene) WHERE rn=1 AND val>=1 AND val>=4*secondval) SELECT t.Tissue, COUNT(e.Gene) enriched_genes, SUM(CASE WHEN blood THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) secreted_to_blood_n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN blood THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.Gene),0),2) secreted_to_blood_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN fda THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fda_target_n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN fda THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(e.Gene),0),2) fda_target_pct FROM rna_tissue_consensus_tissues t LEFT JOIN e ON t.Tissue=e.Tissue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1"}

## Method

Using the consensus RNA tissue matrix, I defined a **tissue-enriched gene** as one with **nTPM ≥ 1** in its highest-expression tissue and expression **at least fourfold greater than in the second-highest tissue**. “Secreted to blood” is the HPA *Secretome location* annotation, and FDA targets are genes whose HPA *Protein class* includes **FDA approved drug targets**.  

Percentages are calculated among enriched genes in the respective tissue; **—** denotes no enriched genes (so a share is undefined).

*Each `█` is approximately 30 genes; exact values are shown at right.*

final_answer:
## Method

Using the consensus RNA tissue matrix, I defined a **tissue-enriched gene** as one with **nTPM ≥ 1** in its highest-expression tissue and expression **at least fourfold greater than in the second-highest tissue**. “Secreted to blood” is the HPA *Secretome location* annotation, and FDA targets are genes whose HPA *Protein class* includes **FDA approved drug targets**.  

Percentages are calculated among enriched genes in the respective tissue; **—** denotes no enriched genes (so a share is undefined).
